objective: Auditar el estado AS-IS canónico de RH/HCM en EDARSAHUB, preservando SQL Server como fuente de verdad y cubriendo reclutamiento, plantilla/vacantes, contratación, expedientes y documentos, empleados, nómina, incidencias, autorizaciones, roles/permisos e integraciones relacionadas. No modificar código, datos, esquema, RBAC, menús, Scheduler, NetPay ni Production.

queries.name: rh_hcm_schema_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' AND (LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%rh%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%emple%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%nomina%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%vacant%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%reclut%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%contrat%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%expedient%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%incidenc%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%infonavit%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%fonacot%') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: rh_hcm_column_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%rh%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%emple%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%nomina%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%vacant%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%reclut%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%contrat%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%expedient%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
